chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn Hadid, from Murazim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the sick person who is unable to perform salat (prayer). He said: Whatever Allah has overpowered him with, then Allah is more entitled to excuse.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the act of worship under discussion
key_terms.الْعُذْرِ: excuse; a recognized dispensation due to inability
key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.غَلَبَ: overpowered or overcame; refers to a condition beyond one's control
key_terms.لَا يَقْدِرُ: is not able; indicates genuine incapacity

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a sick person who cannot perform salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a sick person who is unable to perform salat (prayer). It establishes that when incapacity is imposed by Allah, the person is excused accordingly in the obligation.
